summary: Applying a wished crystal ball stops at the missing doapply CRYSTAL_BALL arm. C calls detect.c use_crystal_ball(), prompts for a symbol, and enters a trap-detection query. Port the whole crystal-ball function, its consumed detector results, and the doapply caller arm.

source.branch: A sighted hero applies a crystal ball with charges. apply.c doapply() selects CRYSTAL_BALL and passes the object pointer to use_crystal_ball(); the non-hallucinating branch asks What do you look for?, receives ^, starts gazing, consumes a charge, and calls trap_detect().
callers: apply.c doapply() at 4358-4360 invokes detect.c use_crystal_ball(&obj).
js/apply.js doapply() currently refuses object type 231 before reaching a detect.c equivalent; command dispatch enters through cmd.c apply command.
dependencies: C use_crystal_ball() consumes the return value of trap_detect() for ^, and also object_detect(), monster_detect(), furniture_detect() for other symbols; port any missing return-valued callee in the same task.
The function mutates the pointed-to crystal ball when it explodes or implodes, consumes charges, schedules gaze occupation via nomul(), and controls prompt/message order.
The doapply caller is currently reserved by the active grease task; this investigation is ready for later selection once that reservation is released.

challenges/cases/v7/crystal-query-reached.session.json: C step 17 after selecting o says You may look for an object, monster, or special map symbol.; step 18 asks What do you look for?; step 19 after ^ says You peer into the glass orb....
